name: aux-boot-default
description: Force the unit to resume AUX on every boot. C_MGR_SRC::StartUp restores the saved source by reading Last_Source into this+0xb4 (the value the scheduler ExecuteAllocationFirstRound matches against each request node's Sched_Pos) with no validation. This edit replaces that load with a constant 7 (POS_AUX in C_MGR_SRC's own scheduler-position enum), so the restore always targets AUX regardless of what is stored in the settings database. This is sticky where a Last_Source database seed is not: the firmware re-saves the active source via C_MGR_SRC::ImmediateSourceSave on every source change, so a DB seed only survives until you next switch source, whereas this patch ignores the saved value entirely. It also removes the need for a /USER_DATA payload (no data-loss risk, no FAT-casing trap). Pair it with aux-always-available so AUX is a valid, selectable source. CAVEAT: this sets the restore target; the scheduler only switches if an AUX request node (Sched_Pos 7) is registered at StartUp - the same downstream condition tracked in docs/AUX_CHAIN.md. NAV only: the StartUp address differs on the AUDIO_BT/AUDIO_BT_256 builds and must be re-derived from each image before adding those variants.

patches.why: C_MGR_SRC::StartUp boot restore: replace `lwz r9,8(r1)` (r9 = saved Last_Source, then stored to this+0xb4 / global 0x035e4cd0 / this+0xe4 at 0x01699490..9c) with `li r9,7`, so the restored scheduler position is always 7 (POS_AUX) instead of the value ImmediateSourceSave persisted. Makes boot-to-AUX sticky across source changes.
